proposition: In MS Majlis 10196 the incipit and explicit of the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (ff. 52a and 118b) are in Ibn Turka's own hand, and the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam carries an autograph note at the end, according to marginal notes in the manuscript as reported by Melvin-Koushki.

mediation.note: an autograph is the strongest witness to what he wrote; its date and the reason it was written out are separate questions
